title: Howard Hughes brought to the Bahamas

tellings.quote: the the island there. And you also have Howard Hughes, who suddenly gets brought down there.

plain: A guest who goes by the name JASON says on Jesse Michels's podcast that Howard Hughes, the rich American aviator and businessman, was suddenly brought to an island in the Bahamas. He mentions it next to other things he links to that island, and gives no date or source. He tells it as a clue in a story about a secret society behind hidden knowledge of UFOs.
